Title: Adani Green adopts TNFD framework, shifts towards nature-positive renewable energy development
Synopsis: Adani Green Energy Ltd (AGEL) has integrated the Taskforce on Nature-related Financial Disclosures (TNFD) framework into its sustainability strategy, strengthening its push toward nature-positive renewable energy development. The company has begun assessing nature-related dependencies and risks across all sites and aims for No Net Loss of Biodiversity by 2030, supported by plans to plant 27.86 million trees.

Title: Interest subsidies lift municipal bond issuances to new record
Synopsis: Municipal bonds in India have reached a record high this fiscal, surpassing ₹1,000 crore, driven by government interest subsidies and SEBI's encouragement. The Nashik Municipal Corporation recently raised ₹200 crore, highlighting the growing attractiveness of this funding avenue for urban local bodies undertaking developmental projects.

Title: ESR acquires 85 acres in Hosur for 2.1 mn sq ft industrial park development
Synopsis: The company has bought 85 acres for the project with a development potential of 2.1 million sq ft. The new facility will strengthen ESR’s presence across South India’s industrial corridor and cater to manufacturing, and research & development-led sectors.

Title: Signature Global raises Rs 875 cr from IFC via issue of debentures
Synopsis: Realty firm Signature Global Ltd has raised Rs 875 crore through issue of non-convertible debentures (NCDs) to World Bank's lending arm IFC for development of mid-income housing projects and reduce debt.

Title: IndoSpace to invest over Rs 500 cr in 66-acre logistics park in Bhiwandi near Mumbai
Synopsis: IndoSpace is set to inject over Rs 500 crore into a 66-acre logistics park in Bhiwandi, near Mumbai, adding 1.7 million sq ft of warehousing space. This investment is part of IndoSpace's commitment to Maharashtra, where it has already invested nearly $330 million.

Title: GNG Electronics IPO opens with robust 44% GMP. Should you subscribe?
Synopsis: GNG Electronics launched its IPO aiming to raise Rs 460 crore through fresh issue and offer for sale, showing strong financials and investor interest with a 44% GMP. The company will use the proceeds to repay debt and for general corporate purposes. Brokerages recommend subscribing, citing GNG's scale, growth, and strategic positioning in the refurbished electronics market.

Title: NHAI GHG Emissions down in 2023-24 despite increase in highway construction
Synopsis: In its Sustainability Report 2023-24, the National Highways Authority of India said it utilised over 631 lakh metric tonnes of recycled and reused materials, including fly-ash, plastic waste, and reclaimed asphalt, in national highway construction in 2023-24, in line with the goal of a circular economy.

Title: ACC on track to build 30% of India’s future? Karan Adani responds
Synopsis: ACC Chairman Karan Adani highlighted the cement industry's pivotal role in India's infrastructure development, projecting significant benefits from the anticipated USD 2.2 trillion investment by 2030. ACC, now exceeding 100 MTPA capacity, aims for 140 MTPA by FY28, leveraging Adani Group synergies in logistics and resources.

Title: Is recession all set to hit US economy? Here's what Americans think
Synopsis: Three in five respondents believe U.S. economic growth will stall and inflation will remain above the 2 per cent Federal Reserve target, with one-in-five respondents expecting inflation above 3.5 per cent.

Title: Sebi expands scope of unpublished price sensitive information
Synopsis: Markets regulator Sebi has widened the ambit of the scope of Unpublished Price Sensitive Information (UPSI) by including any proposed fundraising activities agreements which can impact the management or control of the company, restructuring plans, and one-time bank settlements.

Title: 4 emerging careers in sustainability and green jobs
Synopsis: As the demand for sustainability grows, businesses and governments invest in eco-friendly practices. This has led to emerging careers such as sustainability analysts, carbon accountants, urban sustainability planners, and circular economy specialists. These roles are vital in achieving global sustainability goals and ensuring long-term growth.

Title: ACC Q3 Results: Cons PAT zooms 103% YoY to Rs 1,092 crore, revenue jumps 7%
Synopsis: ACC Q3 Results: On a sequential basis, the profit after tax (PAT) for the Adani Group company surged by 447%, compared to Rs 200 crore reported in Q2FY25. Meanwhile, the topline witnessed a 15% uptick on a quarter-on-quarter basis, compared to Rs 4,521 crore in the July-September quarter.

Title: Adani Group's copper arm, Kutch Copper Ltd joins International Copper Association
Synopsis: Kutch Copper Ltd, part of the AdGroup, has joined the International Copper Association (ICA) to contribute to sustainability initiatives and the copper sector's development. Adani Enterprises is investing USD 1.2 billion in a copper smelter in Gujarat to enhance India's self-reliance in copper production.

Title: CAG to submit report on multi-modal transport, logistics initiatives in Parliament next year
Synopsis: The Comptroller and Auditor General of India will present a significant report on multi-modal transport and logistics initiatives to Parliament. This comprehensive audit, prepared with IIM Mumbai, focuses on improving India's logistics sector. It examines the National Rail Plan and aims to reduce costs and enhance business ease. The report will offer recommendations for seamless cargo movement and digital integration.

Title: Moody's downgrades Tata Motors' outlook over JLR cyber incident
Synopsis: Moody’s downgraded Tata Motors’ outlook to negative from positive following a cyberattack on its British unit Jaguar Land Rover (JLR), which has halted production for at least four weeks. The agency affirmed Tata Motors’ Ba1 corporate family rating but noted the full recovery in credit metrics may take months.

Title: India to double third-party data centre capacity by March 2028: Icra
Synopsis: The data centre space in India has drawn interest from players both old and new, with plans to develop and deliver 3–3.5 gigawatts (GW) capacity over the coming decade. Companies have committed investments to the tune of Rs 2.3–2.5 lakh crore towards this.

Title: India to double third-party data centre capacity by March 2028: ICRA
Synopsis: India's third-party data centre capacity is projected to double to 2,500 MW by March 2028, fueled by a Rs 90,000 crore investment. Favorable policies and incentives are attracting significant investments, with major players like OpenAI and Reliance expanding their presence. While Mumbai dominates, new locations and renewable energy adoption are gaining traction.

Title: Govt aid, corporate funds can be used to finance MSMEs' measures to cut emission: experts
Synopsis: Experts suggest government and CSR funds can aid MSMEs in reducing carbon emissions. Transition to clean energy and climate-informed building codes are crucial. These steps protect MSMEs from climate risks.

Title: Hindustan Zinc shares in focus as board clears Rs 3,823 crore 10 MTPA tailings reprocessing plant
Synopsis: Hindustan Zinc's board has cleared a Rs 3,823 crore plan to set up India’s first zinc tailings reprocessing plant at Rampura Agucha Mine. The 10 MTPA facility will recover metals like zinc and silver, boosting sustainability and production capacity.

Title: Nayara Energy looks inward as overseas options shrink
Synopsis: Hit by EU sanctions due to Rosneft's stake, Nayara Energy offered its export volumes of petrol and diesel to Indian state-run refiners. The company, operating its refinery at 80% capacity, reiterated its commitment to India's energy security. Nayara plans to invest ₹70,000 crore in petrochemicals, ethanol plants, and infrastructure expansion, despite the challenges.

Title: GNG Electronics shares tumble over 8% after listing. Should you buy, sell or hold?
Synopsis: GNG Electronics shares experienced a volatile debut, initially surging nearly 50% above the IPO price before falling over 8% to Rs 325.5 on the NSE. The Rs 460.43 crore IPO, which was oversubscribed 150.21 times, saw investors booking profits after the initial listing gains.

Title: Milky Mist Dairy files for Rs 2,035 crore IPO, targets expansion and debt reduction
Synopsis: Milky Mist Dairy Food has filed for a ₹2,035 crore IPO, including a ₹1,785 crore fresh issue. Funds will be used for debt repayment, capacity expansion, and distribution network enhancement. The company focuses exclusively on value-added dairy products.

Title: Tesla stocks crash: Should you sell or hold for future profits?
Synopsis: Tesla Stocks plunged after CEO Elon Musk's plans to launch a new U.S. political party reignited concerns about his commitment to the company's future as it struggles with declining sales.

Title: EVs, nuclear and forever chemicals: Climate predictions for 2025
Synopsis: Last month the International Energy Agency scrapped its forecast for peak coal consumption, saying use of the world’s dirtiest fuel will continue to break records until at least 2027.

Title: Millennial investing rules: 5 simple money habits young investors use to build wealth
Synopsis: Millennials are changing how people invest money. They use mobile apps, start investing early, and take more risks like crypto. They also plan many income sources and choose investments based on their values. Experts say their biggest lesson is simple: use technology to invest easily, ignore daily market noise, stay disciplined, and focus on long-term financial growth.

Title: Steel firms plan Rs 4,000 crore IPO push amid safeguard duty boost
Synopsis: Steel and steel-linked companies are gearing up to mobilise around Rs 4,000 crore through IPOs over the next 12-18 months, buoyed by the government's decision to impose a three-year safeguard duty on select flat steel imports, merchant bankers said.

Title: Adani clean energy arms see milestone year with scale-up in solar, wind, green hydrogen
Synopsis: Adani Group's clean energy ventures achieved significant milestones in 2025, with Adani Solar reaching 15,000 MW module shipments and Adani Wind surpassing 1 GW of onshore turbine installations. The conglomerate also commissioned India's first off-grid 5 MW green hydrogen pilot plant, underscoring its growing role in the global energy transition.

Title: Investors should eye US and global markets, not just India: Ajay Srivastava
Synopsis: Global markets show surprising resilience, with the US remaining strong and Europe adopting a more pragmatic approach. Ajay Srivastava advises Indian investors to look beyond domestic valuations, suggesting the US as the prime destination for AI investments. He warns of a potential valuation correction in India if short-selling is introduced, urging investors to be selective and encash exuberance.

Title: India Inc faces boardroom gap: Talent for independent directors exists but access remains a hurdle
Synopsis: India Inc. faces a significant imbalance in independent director appointments, with many qualified professionals overlooked due to reliance on personal networks. This results in numerous board vacancies and a small pool serving multiple companies, hindering effective governance. Experts urge companies to broaden their search processes and prioritize merit to access diverse, relevant talent.

Title: Stocks in news: L&T, M&M, Tata Motors, Reliance Power, BEL
Synopsis: Markets saw volatility but ended flat after a recent slide. L&T secured a $700 million facility. M&M sold its Sampo Rosenlew stake. Premier Energies won $19.95 million solar contracts. Reliance Power sold Indonesian coal entities. BEL secured Rs 1092 crore orders. IRFC inked two loan agreements. Tata Motors faced a rating downgrade. Godrej Agrovet received a Sebi warning.

Title: BFSI sector to add 2.5 lakh jobs by 2030; hiring shifts to tier II, III cities: Report
Synopsis: India's Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance sector is poised for significant expansion. Hiring is expected to increase substantially in the coming years. Nearly 2.5 lakh permanent positions will be created by 2030. Demand is growing in tier II and III cities. This shift is away from metro-centric recruitment. Companies are seeking candidates with local language skills.

Title: Cognizant's India M&A team gets consultants to up inorganic growth
Synopsis: Cognizant Technology Solutions is beefing up its mergers and acquisitions team in India. The company has hired at least five executives from consulting firms such as PwC, Deloitte and EY in India as part of the corporate development team to support its M&A efforts.

Title: GNG Electronics IPO subscribed over 102x on day 3; GMP signals strong listing
Synopsis: GNG Electronics' IPO saw overwhelming demand, subscribed 102.06 times, driven by NIIs and retail investors. The IPO includes a fresh issue and OFS, priced at Rs 225-237 per share. SBI Securities and Canara Bank Securities suggest subscribing, citing growth and strategic positioning. The company's revenue and profit have more than doubled in the past two years.

Title: GNG Electronics IPO subscribed nearly 27x on day 2: GMP rises to 42%
Synopsis: GNG Electronics' IPO witnessed strong investor demand, subscribed nearly 27x on its second day, driven by NIIs and retail investors. The IPO includes a fresh issue and an offer for sale, with a price band of Rs 225–237 per share. Brokerages recommend subscribing, citing the company's growth, strategic positioning, and leadership in the refurbished electronics market.

Title: India doubles down on logistics infra as global order shifts from efficiency to resilience
Synopsis: A recent report indicates a significant surge in warehousing activity, driven primarily by manufacturing and e-commerce sectors. This domestic demand insulates India from geopolitical disruptions.

Title: HUL gets first woman CEO, but India Inc still far from gender parity at the top
Synopsis: Hindustan Unilever’s appointment of Priya Nair as its first woman CEO and MD in 92 years marks a milestone, but data shows women remain largely absent in top corporate roles across India. As of July 2024, only nine of the Nifty 200 firms have women CEOs or MDs. Experts cite workplace biases, structural barriers, and societal expectations as key reasons for this persistent gender gap.

Title: Industrial and logistics supply grows by 57% YoY in Q1 2025
Synopsis: India's Industrial & Logistics sector experienced substantial growth in Q1 2025, with new supply surging by 57% to 12.4 million sq. ft., fueled by institutional investor-backed developers. Leasing activity also saw a robust increase of 40%, driven by 3PL and e-commerce sectors, particularly in Delhi-NCR, Hyderabad, and Bengaluru.

Title: Davos 2025: Biz executives say India uniquely placed to lead global sustainability movement
Synopsis: Businesses must view sustainability as an investment rather than a cost as sustainability initiatives deliver long-term financial gains despite high upfront costs, Vaishali Nigam Sinha, co-founder of decarbonisation solutions company ReNew, said. "It's an investment in the future and there's definitely a long-term benefit, even if it seems like a cost right now."

Title: Indian students flock to petroleum and mining programs amid Trump’s second term buzz
Synopsis: Indian students are increasingly opting for courses in extractive industries like petroleum, mining, and agriculture due to anticipated job creation and regulatory leniency under Donald Trump’s policies. Post-pandemic disruptions and attractive salaries within these sectors further contribute to this rising interest.

Title: India set to lead in Asia-Pacific office space supply in 2026
Synopsis: India is set to lead the Asia-Pacific office market in 2026, with Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Delhi-NCR projected to deliver the highest net addition of Grade-A office space in the region. Bengaluru is expected to add 13.09 million sq ft, Hyderabad 9.25 million sq ft, and Delhi-NCR 8.98 million sq ft, surpassing major Asian cities like Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing. Mumbai will add over 4.3 million sq ft.

Title: Buy, Sell or Hold: HDFC Securities initiates coverage on Aditya Birla Lifestyle; Emkay Global sees over 30% upside on Gravita India
Synopsis: Brokerage firms are positive on Gravita India due to its growth plans. HDFC Securities initiates coverage on Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands, anticipating growth and profitability. Nuvama reaffirms its buy rating for United Breweries, citing capacity expansion. These recommendations highlight confidence in companies with growth potential. The firms are strategically positioned to benefit from evolving trends.

Title: Experion Developers earns WELL precertification for 3 landmark residential projects
Synopsis: Experion Developers, in collaboration with the International WELL Building Institute (IWBI) - the global authority on advancing health and well-being in buildings, organizations, and communities - announced on Tuesday that three of its flagship residential projects have received the prestigious WELL Residence Precertification.

Title: Turning waste into wealth: How waste treatment innovation can create jobs and drive green growth
Synopsis: India grapples with a huge waste problem. This challenge presents an opportunity for innovation. Waste can be a valuable resource through recycling and energy conversion. Untreated waste poses health and investment risks. Waste treatment can create jobs and promote green growth. Government policies and private sector involvement are crucial. India can transform its waste crisis into a sustainable future.

Title: Internal audits, balancing assurance and advisory
Synopsis: Internal audit functions are at a crucial point, balancing assurance and advisory roles amid rising regulatory demands and complex risks. Boards seek proactive insights, but capacity and clarity often constrain audit teams. To evolve strategically, internal audit needs committed support from independent directors and a culture of accountability, ensuring its objectivity isn't compromised.

Title: Nayara Energy to invest Rs 70,000 cr in India; says EU sanctions go against India's interests
Synopsis: Nayara Energy, backed by Rosneft, has denounced the EU sanctions as unjust and harmful to India's interests, reaffirming its commitment to invest Rs 70,000 crore in downstream projects. The company argues the sanctions threaten India's energy security by disrupting petroleum product supplies.

Title: India’s real estate turns greener
Synopsis: India's real estate sector is rapidly embracing sustainability, with green-certified buildings becoming increasingly prevalent. A joint CREDAI-Colliers report reveals that approximately 66% of Grade A office spaces in top Indian cities are now green-certified, and this number is expected to rise. This shift is driven by tenant preferences, lower operational costs, and regulatory compliance.

Title: Could Panama throw a new wrench into BlackRock's ports deal?
Synopsis: BlackRock's acquisition of 40 ports, including two near the Panama Canal, is facing delays due to an audit by Panama's government on a concession granted to CK Hutchison. The deal, part of a larger $22.8 billion transaction, is under review amid growing criticism from China and legal challenges in Panama.

Title: Budget 2025: Will Sitharaman and co fuel India's luxe aspirations, premium growth?
Synopsis: Union Budget: As India shifts towards a premium-focused economy, Budget 2025 will likely address the growing demand for luxury goods, easier credit access, urban infrastructure, and sustainability. The government might introduce policies supporting these sectors while ensuring inclusive growth and fostering innovation through tax breaks and targeted funding.

Title: Union Budget 2025's tax dilemma and expectations for Viksit Bharat
Synopsis: India Budget: The Union Budget 2025 is eagerly anticipated, with significant expectations from the banking and financial sectors. Key proposals include adjusting tax rates for foreign banks, abolishing Securities Transaction Tax (STT), extending tax benefits to NBFCs, and enhancing tax incentives for GIFT-IFSC. These changes aim to support India's economic growth and ease of doing business.
